```{r}
# =========================================================
# Dean et al. rat–flea–human plague model
# Barcelona outbreak
# Sensitivity of posterior geometry to flea searching efficiency
# =========================================================

library(yersinia)
library(dplyr)
library(rstan)
library(posterior)
library(bayesplot)
library(GGally)
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)
library(purrr)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 1. Barcelona mortality data
# ---------------------------------------------------------

dat <- outbreaks |>
  dplyr::filter(location == "Barcelona") |>
  dplyr::select(time = day, deaths)

N_city <- outbreaks |>
  dplyr::filter(location == "Barcelona") |>
  dplyr::summarise(population = first(population)) |>
  pull(population)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 2. Initial rat population assumption
# ---------------------------------------------------------
# Dean et al. allow up to 1:1 rat:human ratio.
# We'll use 1 rat per 5 humans as baseline.

Sr0 <- round(N_city / 5)

# ---------------------------------------------------------
# 3. Flea searching efficiency scenarios
# ---------------------------------------------------------

a_vals <- c(
  low  = 1 / Sr0,
  mid  = 3 / Sr0,
  high = 6 / Sr0
)

df_vals <- c(
  low  = 1 / 8,
  mid  = 1 / 5,
  high = 1 / 2
)
a_vals
df_vals
```

```{stan output.var=deanmod}
functions {

  vector plague_rf(
                   real t,
                   vector y,
                   array[] real theta,
                   array[] real x_r,
                   array[] int x_i
                   ) {

    // ---------------------------------------------------
    // Estimated parameters
    // ---------------------------------------------------

    real beta_r = theta[1];
    real beta_h = theta[2];
    real a      = theta[3];

    // ---------------------------------------------------
    // Fixed parameters
    // ---------------------------------------------------

    real gamma_r = theta[4];
    real gamma_h = theta[5];

    real g_r = theta[6];
    real g_h = theta[7];

    real r_f = theta[8];
    real K_f = theta[9];
    real d_f = theta[10];

    // ---------------------------------------------------
    // State variables
    // ---------------------------------------------------

    real Sr = y[1];
    real Ir = y[2];
    real Rr = y[3];
    real Dr = y[4];

    real H  = y[5];
    real F  = y[6];

    real Sh = y[7];
    real Ih = y[8];
    real Rh = y[9];
    real Dh = y[10];

    // ---------------------------------------------------
    // Population sizes
    // ---------------------------------------------------

    real Nr = Sr + Ir + Rr;
    real Nh = Sh + Ih + Rh;

    vector[10] dydt;

    // ---------------------------------------------------
    // Infection forces
    // ---------------------------------------------------

    real lambda_r =

      beta_r *Sr*
      F /
      (Nr + 1e-9) *
      (1 - exp(-a * Nr));

    real lambda_h =

      beta_h *
      F *
      exp(-a * Nr);

    // ---------------------------------------------------
    // Rat dynamics
    // ---------------------------------------------------

    dydt[1] = -lambda_r ;

    dydt[2] =
      lambda_r  -
      gamma_r * Ir;

    dydt[3] =
      g_r * gamma_r * Ir;

    dydt[4] =
      (1 - g_r) * gamma_r * Ir;

    // ---------------------------------------------------
    // Flea population
    // ---------------------------------------------------

    dydt[5] =

      r_f *
      H *
      (1 - H / (K_f * Nr + 1e-9));

    // ---------------------------------------------------
    // Infectious fleas
    // ---------------------------------------------------

    dydt[6] =

      ((1 - g_r) * gamma_r * Ir *H)

      /// (1 + F / 1000)

      - d_f * F;

    // ---------------------------------------------------
    // Human dynamics
    // ---------------------------------------------------

    dydt[7] =
      -lambda_h * Sh;

    dydt[8] =
      lambda_h * Sh -
      gamma_h * Ih;

    dydt[9] =
      g_h * gamma_h * Ih;

    dydt[10] =
      (1 - g_h) *
      gamma_h *
      Ih;

    return dydt;
  }
}

data {

  int<lower=1> N;

  array[N] real ts;

  array[N] int deaths;

  int<lower=1> N_city;

  int<lower=1> Sr0;

  real<lower=0> a_fixed;
}

parameters {

  real<lower=0> beta_r;

  real<lower=0> beta_h;

  real<lower=1> Ir0;

  real<lower=0> H0;

  real<lower=0> phi;
}

transformed parameters {

  vector[10] y0;

  array[10] real theta;

  array[N] vector[10] y_hat;

  vector[N] expected_deaths;

  // ---------------------------------------------------
  // Fixed biological parameters
  // ---------------------------------------------------

  theta[1] = beta_r;
  theta[2] = beta_h;
  theta[3] = a_fixed;

  theta[4] = 1 / 5.2;
  theta[5] = 1 / 10.0;

  theta[6] = 0.1;
  theta[7] = 0.4;

  theta[8] = 0.0084;
  theta[9] = 6.0;
  theta[10] = 1 / 5.0;

  // ---------------------------------------------------
  // Initial conditions
  // ---------------------------------------------------

  y0[1] = Sr0 - Ir0;
  y0[2] = Ir0;
  y0[3] = 0;
  y0[4] = 0;

  y0[5] = fmin(H0, 20);

  y0[6] = 1;

  y0[7] = N_city;
  y0[8] = 1;
  y0[9] = 0;
  y0[10] = 0;

  // ---------------------------------------------------
  // Solve ODE
  // ---------------------------------------------------

  y_hat = ode_rk45(
    plague_rf,
    y0,
    0,
    ts,
    theta,
    rep_array(0.0,0),
    rep_array(0,0)
  );

  // ---------------------------------------------------
  // Expected deaths
  // ---------------------------------------------------

  for(i in 1:N){

    if(i == 1){

      expected_deaths[i] = 1e-6;

    } else {

      expected_deaths[i] =

        fmax(
          y_hat[i,10] -
          y_hat[i-1,10],
          1e-6
        );
    }
  }
}

model {

  // ---------------------------------------------------
  // Priors
  // ---------------------------------------------------

  beta_r ~ lognormal(-3, 0.5);

  beta_h ~ lognormal(-5, 0.5);

  Ir0 ~ lognormal(log(5), 0.5);

  H0 ~ lognormal(log(5), 0.5);

  phi ~ exponential(1);

  // ---------------------------------------------------
  // Likelihood
  // ---------------------------------------------------

  deaths ~ neg_binomial_2(
    expected_deaths,
    phi
  );
}
generated quantities {

  array[N] int y_rep;

  for(i in 1:N){

    y_rep[i] = neg_binomial_2_rng(
      expected_deaths[i],
      phi
    );
  }
}
```

```{r}
inits_fun <- function(){

  list(
    beta_r = runif(1, 0.01, 0.1),
    beta_h = runif(1, 0.001, 0.02),
    Ir0 = runif(1, 1, 10),
    H0 = runif(1, 1, 10),
    phi = runif(1, 1, 5)
  )
}
```

```{r}
stan_data <- list(

  N = nrow(dat),

  ts = as.vector(dat$time),

  deaths = as.integer(dat$deaths),

  N_city = as.integer(N_city),

  Sr0 = as.integer(Sr0),

  a_fixed = a_vals["mid"]
)
```

Fit Mid

```{r}
fit_mid <- rstan::sampling(

  deanmod,

  data = stan_data,

  init = inits_fun,

  chains = 4,

  cores = 4,

  iter = 1000,

  warmup = 500,

  seed = 42,

  control = list(
    adapt_delta = 0.97,
    max_treedepth = 13
  )
)
```

```{r}
post_df <- as.data.frame(

  rstan::extract(

    fit_mid,

    pars = c(
      "beta_r",
      "beta_h",
      "Ir0",
      "H0"
    )
  )

)

post_df <- post_df |>
  dplyr::rename(F0 = H0)
```

```{r}
GGally::ggpairs(post_df)
```

### Actual Sensitivity Analysis

```{r}
fits <- list()

for(i in names(a_vals)){

  cat("Running scenario:", i, "\n")

  stan_data <- list(

    N = nrow(dat),

    ts = as.vector(dat$time),

    deaths = as.integer(dat$deaths),

    N_city = as.integer(N_city),

    Sr0 = as.integer(Sr0),

    a_fixed = a_vals[i]
  )

  fits[[i]] <- sampling(

    deanmod,

    data = stan_data,

    init = inits_fun,

    chains = 4,

    cores = 4,

    iter = 1000,

    warmup = 500,

    seed = 42,

    control = list(
      adapt_delta = 0.99,
      max_treedepth = 13,
      stepsize = 0.01
    )
  )
}
```

### Extraction of posteriors

```{r}
post_df <- map2_df(

  fits,

  names(fits),

  ~{

    as.data.frame(

      rstan::extract(

        .x,

        pars = c(
          "beta_r",
          "beta_h",
          "Ir0",
          "H0"
        )
      )

    ) |>

      mutate(
        a_scenario = .y
      )
  }
)

post_df <- post_df |>
  dplyr::rename(N0 = H0)
```

```{r}
GGally::ggpairs(

  post_df,

  columns = 1:4,

  mapping = aes(
    color = a_scenario,
    alpha = 0.25
  ),

  upper = list(
    continuous = "blank"
  ),

  progress = FALSE
)
```

```{r}
GGally::ggpairs(
  post_df,
  columns = 1:4,
  mapping = aes(
    color = a_scenario
  ),
  lower = list(
    continuous = GGally::wrap("points", alpha = 0.25)
  ),
  upper = list(
    continuous = "blank"
  ),
  legend = 1,
  progress = FALSE
) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```

```{r}
GGally::ggpairs(
  post_df,
  columns = 1:4,
  mapping = aes(
    color = a_scenario
  ),
  lower = list(
    continuous = GGally::wrap("points", alpha = 0.25)
  ),
  upper = list(
    continuous = "blank"
  ),
  legend = 1,
  progress = FALSE
) +
  labs(color = expression(a[scenario])) +
  theme(legend.position = "right")
```
